about: Shared training-block contract (docs/training-blocks.md). Edit this file, then run `node scripts/sync_progression_fixtures.cjs` to copy it into both apps; Android TrainingBlockFixturesTest and iOS TrainingBlockFixtureTests execute every case. `references` are each adjusting muscle's reference range [mev, mavMax] in weekly sets, matching Volume Matrix. `schedule` gives each length's reps-in-reserve target by week (the last is the deload, 4 meaning 4+) and the mid-workout adjustment window for each target (4 is a readiness "more_rir" day in an RIR 3 week; a window stops at 3 unless the target is 4, because 4 means 4+). `performance` compares the previous block week's sets of one workout exercise with this week's ([load, reps], loads in kg). `weeks` cases give the workout exercises in program order with `key`, this week's `sets`, `baseSets` (week 1's count; defaults to `sets`), `primary` and `secondary` muscles, `jointHigh` (High joint-stress ratings in the block so far), `highThisWeek` and `performanceFell`; `additions` are exercise keys in the order sets were added; `feedback` lists each muscle's answers this week. `kind` is first (week 1, with `focus`), next (a following accumulation week) or deload. `expected` gives every exercise's sets, the additions afterwards, and the listed changes: each muscle's weekly sets before and after and its reason codes, in muscle order. `readiness` cases give the pre-workout answers (sleep poor/ok/good, energy low/ok/high, soreness none/some/a_lot), the block week's target (null outside a block) and whether it is the deload; `expected` says whether a lighter day is offered, its options in order, and the target after "more_rir". `fewerSets` cases give an exercise's planned `sets` and rows (`done`, `warmup`); `expected` is the rows kept, by index, and the exercise's sets after "fewer_sets". `strength` holds the strength-block contract: `schedule` gives each number of weeks to the test week (0 is the test, 1 the taper) with the lifts' top set (`reps`, `rir`) and back-off sets (`sets`, `reps`, `percent`) or the test's attempt percentages; `weeks` gives a block's lifts and other exercises and every week's sets; `loads`, `backoffs` and `attempts` give loads in `unit` for a barbell `exercise` on the default plates and Olympic bar: a top set from an estimated 1RM (`e1rm`), a back-off from a logged top set, and the test's three singles.
